source_text:
3.6 Εὐτόκιον γενναιότατον πάνυ
Πολύγονόν ἐστι πόα πολλὴ πανταχοῦ ὅπερ λέγεται καὶ «δρῶσα»· ἥτις ἐνδεθεῖσα
χορίῳ κυνὸς ἐσμυρνισμένῳ καὶ ὡς χρὴ κεκαθαρμένῳ καὶ περιαφθεῖσα αἰτία
κυήσεως γίνεται. Ἵνα δὲ ὃ θέλεις συλλάβῃ τὸ ζῷον, εἴτε ἄρρεν εἴτε θῆλυ, λινόζωστις
καὶ περιστερεὼν βοτάναι ἄρρενες εἶναι δοκοῦσι καὶ θήλειαι, ἄρρενες μὲν αἱ ὄρθιαι,
αἱ ἡπλωμέναι δὲ τοὐναντίον. Ταύτας σὺν τοῖς προτέροις φορεῖν ποίει, ἂν μὲν βούλῃ
ἄρρεν τεκεῖν, ἄρρενα, ἂν δὲ θῆλυ, θήλειαν.
pass_a_gloss: 3.6 Easy-birth most-genuine very. Many-seeded is a herb much everywhere which is-said also 'drōsa'; which having-been-bound in-a-chorion of-a-dog having-been-myrrhed and as must having-been-cleaned and having-been-hung-around a-cause of-conception becomes. So-that what you-want may-conceive the animal, whether male or female, linozostis and peristereon herbs males to-be they-seem and females, males yes the upright, the spread-out but the-contrary. These with the former to-wear make, if yes you-wish male to-bear, male, if female, female.
pass_b_english: A most genuine easy-birth, very much so. Polygonon is a herb plentiful everywhere, which is also called drōsa. Bound in a dog's chorion that has been treated with myrrh and cleaned as it must be, and hung around, it becomes a cause of conception.

So that the animal may conceive what you want, whether male or female: the herbs linozostis and peristereon are thought to be male and female — males the upright ones, the spread-out the contrary. Make it wear these with the former: if you wish it to bear a male, a male herb; if a female, a female.

choices.term: ἄρρενες μὲν αἱ ὄρθιαι, αἱ ἡπλωμέναι δὲ τοὐναντίον
choices.english: males the upright ones, the spread-out the contrary
choices.why: Gender of the herb is by habit: standing vs lying-spread, not two species invented.
